322: class ProjectTreeModel(QAbstractItemModel):
323:     """Дерево проекта для ``QTreeView``."""
324: 
325:     #: Заголовки колонок.
326:     HEADERS: tuple[str, str] = ("Объект", "Значение")
327: 
328:     def __init__(self, parent: QObject | None = None) -> None:
329:         super().__init__(parent)
330:         self._root = TreeNode(label="", kind=NodeKind.ROOT, path="")
331:         self._by_path: dict[str, TreeNode] = {}
332:         self._filter = ""
333:         self._visible: dict[int, list[TreeNode]] = {}
334:         self._matches_cache: dict[int, bool] = {}
335: 
336:     # --- наполнение -----------------------------------------------------
337: 
338:     def set_document(self, document: ProjectDocument) -> None:
339:         """Перестраивает дерево из документа."""
340:         self.beginResetModel()
341:         self._root = build_tree(document)
342:         self._by_path = {node.path: node for node in self.walk()}
343:         self._visible.clear()
344:         self._matches_cache.clear()
345:         self.endResetModel()
346: 
347:     def set_issues(self, issues: list[Issue]) -> None:
348:         """Раскладывает замечания по узлам и поднимает счётчики к корню."""
349:         self.beginResetModel()
350:         nodes = list(self.walk())
351:         for node in nodes:
352:             node.errors = 0
353:             node.warnings = 0
354:         for item in issues:
355:             target = self.node_for_path(item.path)
356:             if target is None:
357:                 continue
358:             if item.severity is Severity.ERROR:
359:                 target.errors += 1
360:             else:
361:                 target.warnings += 1
362:         for node in reversed(nodes):
363:             if node.parent is not None:
364:                 node.parent.errors += node.errors
365:                 node.parent.warnings += node.warnings
366:         self.endResetModel()
367: 
368:     def set_filter(self, text: str) -> None:
369:         """Показывает узлы, совпавшие с фильтром, и их предков."""
370:         self.beginResetModel()
371:         self._filter = text.strip().casefold()
372:         self._visible.clear()
373:         self._matches_cache.clear()
374:         self.endResetModel()
375: 
376:     @property
377:     def filter_text(self) -> str:
378:         return self._filter
379: 
380:     # --- поиск узлов ----------------------------------------------------
381: 
382:     def walk(self) -> list[TreeNode]:
383:         """Все узлы в порядке обхода в глубину."""
384:         result: list[TreeNode] = []
385:         stack = [self._root]
386:         while stack:
387:             node = stack.pop()
388:             result.append(node)
389:             stack.extend(reversed(node.children))
390:         return result
391: 
392:     def node_for_path(self, path: str) -> TreeNode | None:
393:         """Узел по точному пути или ближайший существующий предок."""
394:         node = self._by_path.get(path)
395:         if node is not None:
396:             return node
397:         parts = path.split(".")
398:         while parts:
399:             parts.pop()
400:             candidate = self._by_path.get(".".join(parts))
401:             if candidate is not None:
402:                 return candidate
403:         return None
404: 
405:     def index_for_path(self, path: str) -> QModelIndex:
406:         """Индекс узла по пути; невалидный индекс, если пути нет."""
407:         node = self._by_path.get(path)
408:         if node is None:
409:             return QModelIndex()
410:         return self._index_for_node(node)
411: 
412:     def _index_for_node(self, node: TreeNode) -> QModelIndex:
413:         chain: list[TreeNode] = []
414:         current: TreeNode | None = node
415:         while current is not None and current is not self._root:
416:             chain.append(current)
417:             current = current.parent
418:         index = QModelIndex()
419:         for item in reversed(chain):
420:             parent = item.parent
421:             if parent is None:
422:                 return QModelIndex()
423:             siblings = self._children(parent)
424:             try:
425:                 row = siblings.index(item)
426:             except ValueError:
427:                 return QModelIndex()
428:             index = self.index(row, 0, index if index.isValid() else QModelIndex())
429:         return index
430: 
431:     # --- фильтрация -----------------------------------------------------
432: 
433:     def _matches(self, node: TreeNode) -> bool:
434:         if not self._filter:
435:             return True
436:         haystack = (node.label, node.path, node.value_text)
437:         return any(self._filter in part.casefold() for part in haystack)
438: 
439:     def _subtree_matches(self, node: TreeNode) -> bool:
440:         key = id(node)
441:         cached = self._matches_cache.get(key)
442:         if cached is not None:
443:             return cached
444:         result = self._matches(node) or any(self._subtree_matches(child) for child in node.children)
445:         self._matches_cache[key] = result
446:         return result
447: 
448:     def _children(self, node: TreeNode) -> list[TreeNode]:
449:         if not self._filter:
450:             return node.children
451:         key = id(node)
452:         cached = self._visible.get(key)
453:         if cached is None:
454:             cached = [child for child in node.children if self._subtree_matches(child)]
455:             self._visible[key] = cached
456:         return cached
457: 
458:     # --- QAbstractItemModel ---------------------------------------------
459: 
460:     def _node(self, index: IndexLike | None) -> TreeNode | None:
461:         """Узел из индекса Qt; ``None`` для невалидного индекса."""
462:         if index is None or not index.isValid():
463:             return None
464:         pointer = index.internalPointer()
465:         return pointer if isinstance(pointer, TreeNode) else None
466: 
467:     def rowCount(self, parent: IndexLike | None = None) -> int:
468:         if parent is None or not parent.isValid():
469:             return len(self._children(self._root))
470:         node = self._node(parent)
471:         return 0 if node is None else len(self._children(node))
472: 
473:     def columnCount(self, parent: IndexLike | None = None) -> int:
474:         return len(self.HEADERS)
475: 
476:     def index(
477:         self,
478:         row: int,
479:         column: int,
480:         parent: IndexLike | None = None,
481:     ) -> QModelIndex:
482:         parent_node = self._root
483:         if parent is not None and parent.isValid():
484:             candidate = self._node(parent)
485:             if candidate is None:
486:                 return QModelIndex()
487:             parent_node = candidate
488:         children = self._children(parent_node)
489:         if not 0 <= row < len(children) or not 0 <= column < len(self.HEADERS):
490:             return QModelIndex()
491:         return self.createIndex(row, column, children[row])
492: 
493:     def parent(self, index: IndexLike | None = None) -> QModelIndex:  # type: ignore[override]
494:         node = self._node(index)
495:         if node is None or node.parent is None or node.parent is self._root:
496:             return QModelIndex()
497:         return self._index_for_node(node.parent)
498: 
499:     def data(
500:         self,
501:         index: IndexLike | None,
502:         role: int = int(Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole),
503:     ) -> Any:
504:         node = self._node(index)
505:         if node is None or index is None:
506:             return None
507: 
508:         if role == int(Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole):
509:             if index.column() == 1:
510:                 return node.value_text
511:             return self._label_with_badge(node)
512:         if role == int(Qt.ItemDataRole.DecorationRole) and index.column() == 0:
513:             return self._icon_for(node)
514:         if role == int(Qt.ItemDataRole.ToolTipRole):
515:             return self._tooltip(node)
516:         if role == int(Qt.ItemDataRole.ForegroundRole):
517:             if node.errors:
518:                 return QColor("#e5534b")
519:             if node.warnings:
520:                 return QColor("#c69026")
521:             return None
522:         if role == int(Qt.ItemDataRole.FontRole) and node.kind in (NodeKind.ROOT, NodeKind.GROUP):
523:             font = QFont()
524:             font.setBold(True)
525:             return font
526:         if role == PATH_ROLE:
527:             return node.path
528:         if role == KIND_ROLE:
529:             return str(node.kind)
530:         return None
531: 
532:     def headerData(
533:         self,
534:         section: int,
535:         orientation: Qt.Orientation,
536:         role: int = int(Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole),
537:     ) -> Any:
538:         if role != int(Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole):
539:             return None
540:         if orientation == Qt.Orientation.Horizontal and 0 <= section < len(self.HEADERS):
541:             return self.HEADERS[section]
542:         return None
543: 
544:     def flags(self, index: IndexLike | None) -> Qt.ItemFlag:
545:         if index is None or not index.isValid():
546:             return Qt.ItemFlag.NoItemFlags
547:         return Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsEnabled | Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsSelectable
548: 
549:     # --- оформление -----------------------------------------------------
550: 
551:     def _label_with_badge(self, node: TreeNode) -> str:
552:         if node.errors and node.warnings:
553:             return f"{node.label}  ⚠{node.errors} !{node.warnings}"
554:         if node.errors:
555:             return f"{node.label}  ⚠{node.errors}"
556:         if node.warnings:
557:             return f"{node.label}  !{node.warnings}"
558:         return node.label
559: 
560:     def _tooltip(self, node: TreeNode) -> str:
561:         lines = [node.label, f"путь: {node.path or '<корень>'}"]
562:         if node.errors:
563:             lines.append(f"ошибок: {node.errors}")
564:         if node.warnings:
565:             lines.append(f"предупреждений: {node.warnings}")
566:         return "\n".join(lines)
567: 
568:     def _icon_for(self, node: TreeNode) -> Any:
569:         if node.kind is NodeKind.ROOT:
570:             return letter_icon("S", GROUP_COLORS["project"])
571:         if node.kind is NodeKind.GROUP:
572:             letter = getattr(node, "icon_letter", "•")
573:             return letter_icon(str(letter), GROUP_COLORS.get(node.section, GROUP_COLORS["entity"]))
574:         if node.kind is NodeKind.ENTITY:
575:             return letter_icon("•", GROUP_COLORS["entity"], 10)
576:         return None

214: @dataclass
215: class TreeNode:
216:     """Узел дерева проекта."""
217: 
218:     label: str
219:     kind: NodeKind
220:     path: str
221:     value_text: str = ""
222:     section: str = ""
223:     icon_letter: str = ""
224:     errors: int = 0
225:     warnings: int = 0

228: 
229: 
230: def _field_key(name: str, model: type[BaseModel]) -> str:
231:     """Имя поля в JSON: алиас, если он задан (``class`` вместо ``klass``)."""
232:     info = model.model_fields.get(name)
233:     alias = getattr(info, "alias", None) if info is not None else None
234:     return str(alias or name)
235: 
236: 
237: def _ident(item: Any, index: int) -> str:
238:     """Подпись элемента списка: его id, иначе тип, иначе номер."""
239:     if isinstance(item, BaseModel):
240:         for key in _ID_FIELDS:
241:             value = getattr(item, key, None)
242:             if value:
243:                 return str(value)
244:         for key in ("type", "kind", "klass", "name"):
245:             value = getattr(item, key, None)
246:             if value:
247:                 return f"#{index} {value}"
248:     return f"#{index}"
249: 
250: 
251: def _describe(value: Any) -> str:
252:     """Короткое текстовое представление значения для второй колонки."""
253:     if isinstance(value, BaseModel):
254:         return value.__class__.__name__
255:     if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
256:         return f"{len(value)} эл."
257:     if isinstance(value, bool):
258:         return "да" if value else "нет"
259:     if value is None:
260:         return "—"
261:     return str(value)
262: 
263: 
264: def _build(value: Any, *, label: str, path: str, kind: NodeKind, section: str) -> TreeNode:
265:     """Строит поддерево для значения любого типа."""
266:     node = TreeNode(label=label, kind=kind, path=path, section=section)
267:     if isinstance(value, BaseModel):
268:         model = type(value)
269:         for name in model.model_fields:
270:             key = _field_key(name, model)
271:             child_path = f"{path}.{key}" if path else key
272:             child_kind = NodeKind.ENTITY if key in ENTITY_FIELDS else NodeKind.FIELD
273:             node.children.append(
274:                 _build(
275:                     getattr(value, name),
276:                     label=FIELD_TITLES.get(key, key),
277:                     path=child_path,
278:                     kind=child_kind,
279:                     section=section,
280:                 )
281:             )
282:     elif isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
283:         for index, item in enumerate(value):
284:             node.children.append(
285:                 _build(
286:                     item,
287:                     label=_ident(item, index),
288:                     path=f"{path}.{index}",
289:                     kind=NodeKind.ENTITY,
290:                     section=section,
291:                 )
292:             )
293:     else:
294:         node.value_text = _describe(value)
295:     return node
296: 
297: 
298: def _link(node: TreeNode) -> None:
299:     """Проставляет ссылки на родителей."""
300:     for child in node.children:
301:         child.parent = node
302:         _link(child)

304: 
305: def build_tree(document: ProjectDocument) -> TreeNode:
306:     """Строит корень дерева: проект и шесть групп разделов."""
307:     root = TreeNode(label=document.name, kind=NodeKind.ROOT, path="", section="project")
308:     for name, title, letter in SECTION_FIELDS:
309:         group = _build(
310:             getattr(document, name),
311:             label=title,
312:             path=name,
313:             kind=NodeKind.GROUP,
314:             section=name,
315:         )
316:         group.icon_letter = letter
317:         root.children.append(group)
318:     _link(root)
319:     return root

322: class ProjectTreeModel(QAbstractItemModel):
323:     """Дерево проекта для ``QTreeView``."""
324: 
325:     #: Заголовки колонок.
326:     HEADERS: tuple[str, str] = ("Объект", "Значение")
327: 
328:     def __init__(self, parent: QObject | None = None) -> None:
329:         super().__init__(parent)
330:         self._root = TreeNode(label="", kind=NodeKind.ROOT, path="")
331:         self._by_path: dict[str, TreeNode] = {}
332:         self._filter = ""
333:         self._visible: dict[int, list[TreeNode]] = {}
334:         self._matches_cache: dict[int, bool] = {}
335: 
336:     # --- наполнение -----------------------------------------------------
337: 
338:     def set_document(self, document: ProjectDocument) -> None:
339:         """Перестраивает дерево из документа."""
340:         self.beginResetModel()
341:         self._root = build_tree(document)
342:         self._by_path = {node.path: node for node in self.walk()}
343:         self._visible.clear()
344:         self._matches_cache.clear()
345:         self.endResetModel()
346: 
347:     def set_issues(self, issues: list[Issue]) -> None:
348:         """Раскладывает замечания по узлам и поднимает счётчики к корню."""
349:         self.beginResetModel()
350:         nodes = list(self.walk())
351:         for node in nodes:
352:             node.errors = 0
353:             node.warnings = 0
354:         for item in issues:
355:             target = self.node_for_path(item.path)
356:             if target is None:
357:                 continue
358:             if item.severity is Severity.ERROR:
359:                 target.errors += 1
360:             else:
361:                 target.warnings += 1
362:         for node in reversed(nodes):
363:             if node.parent is not None:
364:                 node.parent.errors += node.errors
365:                 node.parent.warnings += node.warnings
366:         self.endResetModel()
367: 
368:     def set_filter(self, text: str) -> None:
369:         """Показывает узлы, совпавшие с фильтром, и их предков."""
370:         self.beginResetModel()
371:         self._filter = text.strip().casefold()
372:         self._visible.clear()
373:         self._matches_cache.clear()
374:         self.endResetModel()
375: 
376:     @property
377:     def filter_text(self) -> str:
378:         return self._filter
379: 
380:     # --- поиск узлов ----------------------------------------------------
381: 
382:     def walk(self) -> list[TreeNode]:
383:         """Все узлы в порядке обхода в глубину."""
384:         result: list[TreeNode] = []
385:         stack = [self._root]
386:         while stack:
387:             node = stack.pop()
388:             result.append(node)
389:             stack.extend(reversed(node.children))
390:         return result
391: 
392:     def node_for_path(self, path: str) -> TreeNode | None:
393:         """Узел по точному пути или ближайший существующий предок."""
394:         node = self._by_path.get(path)
395:         if node is not None:
396:             return node
397:         parts = path.split(".")
398:         while parts:
399:             parts.pop()
400:             candidate = self._by_path.get(".".join(parts))
401:             if candidate is not None:
402:                 return candidate
403:         return None
404: 
405:     def index_for_path(self, path: str) -> QModelIndex:
406:         """Индекс узла по пути; невалидный индекс, если пути нет."""
407:         node = self._by_path.get(path)
408:         if node is None:
409:             return QModelIndex()
410:         return self._index_for_node(node)
411: 
412:     def _index_for_node(self, node: TreeNode) -> QModelIndex:
413:         chain: list[TreeNode] = []
414:         current: TreeNode | None = node
415:         while current is not None and current is not self._root:
416:             chain.append(current)
417:             current = current.parent
418:         index = QModelIndex()
419:         for item in reversed(chain):
420:             parent = item.parent
421:             if parent is None:
422:                 return QModelIndex()
423:             siblings = self._children(parent)
424:             try:
425:                 row = siblings.index(item)
426:             except ValueError:
427:                 return QModelIndex()
428:             index = self.index(row, 0, index if index.isValid() else QModelIndex())
429:         return index
430: 
431:     # --- фильтрация -----------------------------------------------------
432: 
433:     def _matches(self, node: TreeNode) -> bool:
434:         if not self._filter:
435:             return True
436:         haystack = (node.label, node.path, node.value_text)
437:         return any(self._filter in part.casefold() for part in haystack)
438: 
439:     def _subtree_matches(self, node: TreeNode) -> bool:
440:         key = id(node)
441:         cached = self._matches_cache.get(key)
442:         if cached is not None:
443:             return cached
444:         result = self._matches(node) or any(self._subtree_matches(child) for child in node.children)
445:         self._matches_cache[key] = result
446:         return result
447: 
448:     def _children(self, node: TreeNode) -> list[TreeNode]:
449:         if not self._filter:
450:             return node.children
451:         key = id(node)
452:         cached = self._visible.get(key)
453:         if cached is None:
454:             cached = [child for child in node.children if self._subtree_matches(child)]
455:             self._visible[key] = cached
456:         return cached
457: 
458:     # --- QAbstractItemModel ---------------------------------------------
459: 
460:     def _node(self, index: IndexLike | None) -> TreeNode | None:
461:         """Узел из индекса Qt; ``None`` для невалидного индекса."""
462:         if index is None or not index.isValid():
463:             return None
464:         pointer = index.internalPointer()
465:         return pointer if isinstance(pointer, TreeNode) else None
466: 
467:     def rowCount(self, parent: IndexLike | None = None) -> int:
468:         if parent is None or not parent.isValid():
469:             return len(self._children(self._root))
470:         node = self._node(parent)
471:         return 0 if node is None else len(self._children(node))
472: 
473:     def columnCount(self, parent: IndexLike | None = None) -> int:
474:         return len(self.HEADERS)
475: 
476:     def index(
477:         self,
478:         row: int,
479:         column: int,
480:         parent: IndexLike | None = None,
481:     ) -> QModelIndex:
482:         parent_node = self._root
483:         if parent is not None and parent.isValid():
484:             candidate = self._node(parent)
485:             if candidate is None:
486:                 return QModelIndex()
487:             parent_node = candidate
488:         children = self._children(parent_node)
489:         if not 0 <= row < len(children) or not 0 <= column < len(self.HEADERS):
490:             return QModelIndex()
491:         return self.createIndex(row, column, children[row])
492: 
493:     def parent(self, index: IndexLike | None = None) -> QModelIndex:  # type: ignore[override]
494:         node = self._node(index)
495:         if node is None or node.parent is None or node.parent is self._root:
496:             return QModelIndex()
497:         return self._index_for_node(node.parent)
498: 
499:     def data(
500:         self,
501:         index: IndexLike | None,
502:         role: int = int(Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole),
503:     ) -> Any:
504:         node = self._node(index)
505:         if node is None or index is None:
506:             return None
507: 
508:         if role == int(Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole):
509:             if index.column() == 1:
510:                 return node.value_text
511:             return self._label_with_badge(node)
512:         if role == int(Qt.ItemDataRole.DecorationRole) and index.column() == 0:
513:             return self._icon_for(node)
514:         if role == int(Qt.ItemDataRole.ToolTipRole):
515:             return self._tooltip(node)
516:         if role == int(Qt.ItemDataRole.ForegroundRole):
517:             if node.errors:
518:                 return QColor("#e5534b")
519:             if node.warnings:
520:                 return QColor("#c69026")
521:             return None
522:         if role == int(Qt.ItemDataRole.FontRole) and node.kind in (NodeKind.ROOT, NodeKind.GROUP):
523:             font = QFont()
524:             font.setBold(True)
525:             return font
526:         if role == PATH_ROLE:
527:             return node.path
528:         if role == KIND_ROLE:
529:             return str(node.kind)
530:         return None
531: 
532:     def headerData(
533:         self,
534:         section: int,
535:         orientation: Qt.Orientation,
536:         role: int = int(Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole),
537:     ) -> Any:
538:         if role != int(Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole):
539:             return None
540:         if orientation == Qt.Orientation.Horizontal and 0 <= section < len(self.HEADERS):
541:             return self.HEADERS[section]
542:         return None
543: 
544:     def flags(self, index: IndexLike | None) -> Qt.ItemFlag:
545:         if index is None or not index.isValid():
546:             return Qt.ItemFlag.NoItemFlags
547:         return Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsEnabled | Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsSelectable
548: 
549:     # --- оформление -----------------------------------------------------
550: 
551:     def _label_with_badge(self, node: TreeNode) -> str:
552:         if node.errors and node.warnings:
553:             return f"{node.label}  ⚠{node.errors} !{node.warnings}"
554:         if node.errors:
555:             return f"{node.label}  ⚠{node.errors}"
556:         if node.warnings:
557:             return f"{node.label}  !{node.warnings}"
558:         return node.label
559: 
560:     def _tooltip(self, node: TreeNode) -> str:
561:         lines = [node.label, f"путь: {node.path or '<корень>'}"]
562:         if node.errors:
563:             lines.append(f"ошибок: {node.errors}")
564:         if node.warnings:
565:             lines.append(f"предупреждений: {node.warnings}")
566:         return "\n".join(lines)

568:     def _icon_for(self, node: TreeNode) -> Any:
569:         if node.kind is NodeKind.ROOT:
570:             return letter_icon("S", GROUP_COLORS["project"])
571:         if node.kind is NodeKind.GROUP:
572:             letter = getattr(node, "icon_letter", "•")
573:             return letter_icon(str(letter), GROUP_COLORS.get(node.section, GROUP_COLORS["entity"]))
574:         if node.kind is NodeKind.ENTITY:
575:             return letter_icon("•", GROUP_COLORS["entity"], 10)

86:     _write(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

88: 
89: def _load(path: Path) -> ProjectDocument:
90:     return load_project(path).document
91: 
92: 
93: def _exercise(document: ProjectDocument, index: int) -> ExerciseSection:
94:     if not document.exercises:
95:         raise ProjectError("в проекте нет упражнений")
96:     if not 0 <= index < len(document.exercises):
97:         raise ProjectError(
98:             f"упражнение с номером {index} не найдено: в проекте {len(document.exercises)}"
99:         )
100:     return document.exercises[index]
101: 
102: 
103: def _mission(exercise: ExerciseSection, index: int) -> Mission:
104:     if not exercise.missions:
105:         raise ProjectError(f"в упражнении {exercise.exercise_id!r} нет миссий")
106:     if not 0 <= index < len(exercise.missions):
107:         raise ProjectError(
108:             f"миссия с номером {index} не найдена: в упражнении {len(exercise.missions)}"
109:         )
110:     return exercise.missions[index]
111: 
112: 
113: def _agent(document: ProjectDocument, mission: Mission) -> AgentSection | None:
114:     for agent in document.agents:
115:         if agent.agent_id == mission.agent_id:
116:             return agent
117:     return None
118: 
119: 
120: def _cmd_run(args: argparse.Namespace, *, as_json: bool, logger: logging.Logger) -> int:
121:     document = _load(args.path)
122:     exercise = _exercise(document, args.exercise)
123:     mission = _mission(exercise, args.mission)
124:     config = SimulationConfig(
125:         scale=args.scale,
126:         step_s=args.step,
127:         duration_s=args.duration,
128:         slots=args.slots,
129:         realtime_drop=bool(args.realtime_drop),
130:         degradation=Degradation(
131:             sensor_latency_ms=args.latency_ms,
132:             frame_loss_ratio=args.loss,
133:             desync_ms=args.desync_ms,
134:             exposure_jitter_us=args.jitter_us,
135:         ),
136:         work_ms=args.work_ms,
137:         slowdown=args.slowdown,
138:         record_path=args.record,
139:         report_path=args.report,
140:         pace=not args.no_pace,
141:     )
142:     runner = SimulationRunner(mission, agent=_agent(document, mission), config=config)
143:     try:
144:         report = runner.run()
145:     finally:
146:         runner.close()
147:     if as_json:
148:         _write_json(report.to_dict())
149:     else:
150:         _write(report.summary())
151:         _write(
152:             f"масштаб {report.clock.get('scale', 1.0):g}"
153:             f" · шаг {report.clock.get('step_s', 0.0) * 1000:.2f} мс"
154:             f" · интервалов {report.metrics.get('intervals', 0)}"
155:             f" · потеря {report.loss_ratio * 100:.2f}%"
156:         )
157:         if report.record:
158:             _write(f"поток: {report.record}")
159:         if report.status:
160:             _write(f"состояние: {report.status}")
161:         if report.reason:
162:             _write(f"причина: {report.reason}")
163:     if not report.ok:
164:         logger.error("прогон не завершён: %s (%s)", report.state, report.reason)
165:         return int(ExitCode.DATA_ERROR)
166:     return int(ExitCode.OK)
167: 
168: 
169: def _cmd_replay(args: argparse.Namespace, *, as_json: bool, logger: logging.Logger) -> int:
170:     report = replay_stream(args.path, compare=not args.no_compare)
171:     if as_json:
172:         _write_json(report.to_dict())
173:     else:
174:         _write(
175:             f"поток {report.source}: кадров {report.frames}"
176:             f" · совпало {report.matched}"
177:             f" · расхождений {len(report.mismatched)}"
178:             f" · нарушений меток {len(report.bad_timing)}"
179:         )
180:         if report.mismatched:
181:             _write(f"  расхождения: {', '.join(str(i) for i in report.mismatched[:10])}")
182:         if report.bad_timing:
183:             _write(f"  метки: {', '.join(str(i) for i in report.bad_timing[:10])}")
184:     if not report.ok:
185:         logger.error(
186:             "replay не совпал: расхождений %d, нарушений меток %d",
187:             len(report.mismatched),
188:             len(report.bad_timing),
189:         )
190:         return int(ExitCode.DATA_ERROR)
191:     return int(ExitCode.OK)
192: 
193: 
194: def run_sim_command(args: argparse.Namespace, *, as_json: bool, logger: logging.Logger) -> int:
195:     """Диспетчер подкоманд ``sim``."""
196:     command = getattr(args, "sim_command", None)
197:     try:
198:         if command == "run":
199:             return _cmd_run(args, as_json=as_json, logger=logger)
200:         if command == "replay":
201:             return _cmd_replay(args, as_json=as_json, logger=logger)
202:     except (ProjectError, ValueError) as exc:
203:         logger.error("%s", exc)
204:         if as_json:
205:             _write_json({"status": "error", "error": str(exc)})
206:         else:
207:             sys.stderr.write(f"simorph: {exc}\n")
208:         return int(ExitCode.DATA_ERROR)
209:     logger.error("не указано действие для sim: run или replay")

1: """Headless-прогон миссии: часы, кадры, супервизор и метрики (T7-05, G7-01).
2: 
3: Раннер — единственный сценарий исполнения: его используют и CLI
4: (``simorph sim run``), и вкладка «Симуляция». Оконный режим добавляет
5: только визуализацию, поэтому метрики совпадают.
6: 
7: Один такт делает ровно одно и то же: выпускает кадр с метками времени,
8: пропускает его через инжекцию деградации, кладёт в кольцо, забирает
9: готовые кадры, продвигает часы и супервизор, пишет статистику. Такт
10: никогда не пропускается: при нехватке производительности растягивается
11: время PC, а не время сцены (мягкий масштаб, FR-SIM-16).
12: 
13: Сбой внутри такта не выходит наружу: прогон переводится в ``interrupted``,
14: поток кадров и журнал событий остаются читаемыми (FR-SIM-14, G7-07).
15: """
16:

18:

20: import json

24: from dataclasses import dataclass, field

34: from simorph.core.simulation.metrics import (

58: @dataclass(slots=True)
59: class SimulationConfig:
60:     """Параметры прогона: шаг, масштаб, транспорт, деградация, артефакты."""
61: 
62:     sensor_hz: float | None = None
63:     step_s: float | None = None

66:     slots: int = 3

70:     slowdown: float = 1.0
71:     realtime_drop: bool = False
72:     degradation: Degradation = field(default_factory=Degradation)
73:     record_path: Path | None = None
74:     report_path: Path | None = None
75:     interval_s: float = DEFAULT_INTERVAL_S

80:     def __post_init__(self) -> None:

82:             raise ValueError("частота источника должна быть положительной")
83:         if self.step_s is not None and self.step_s <= 0.0:
84:             raise ValueError("шаг физики должен быть положительным")

136: 
137:     @property
138:     def loss_ratio(self) -> float:

140: 
141:     def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
142:         return {
143:             "status": "ok" if self.ok else "error",
144:             "state": self.state,
145:             "reason": self.reason,
146:             "mission_id": self.mission_id,
147:             "agent_id": self.agent_id,
148:             "config": dict(self.config),
149:             "clock": dict(self.clock),
150:             "supervisor": dict(self.supervisor),
151:             "metrics": dict(self.metrics),
152:             "frames": dict(self.frames),
153:             "events": list(self.events),
154:             "record": self.record,
155:             "status_file": self.status,
156:         }
157: 
158:     def summary(self) -> str:
159:         """Короткая сводка для CLI и панели прогона."""
160:         frames = self.frames
161:         return (
162:             f"прогон {self.state}: миссия {self.mission_id} ({self.agent_id})"
163:             f" · сцена {self.clock.get('sim_time_s', 0.0):.1f} с"
164:             f" · PC {self.clock.get('wall_time_s', 0.0):.1f} с"
165:             f" · тактов {frames.get('attempted', 0)}"
166:             f" · кадров {frames.get('pushed', 0)}/{frames.get('consumed', 0)}"
167:             f" · потерь {frames.get('dropped', 0)}"
168:             f" ({self.loss_ratio * 100:.2f}%)"
169:             f" · k p50 {self.metrics.get('k', {}).get('p50', 1.0):.2f},"
170:             f" p95 {self.metrics.get('k', {}).get('p95', 1.0):.2f}"
171:             f" · событий {len(self.events)}"
172:         )

174: 
175: class SimulationRunner:
176:     """Headless-прогон: такты, кадры, состояния и артефакты."""
177: 
178:     def __init__(
179:         self,
180:         mission: Mission,
181:         *,
182:         agent: AgentSection | None = None,
183:         config: SimulationConfig | None = None,
184:         frame_source: Callable[[int, int], bytes] | None = None,
185:         now_ns: Callable[[], int] | None = None,
186:         sleep: Callable[[float], None] | None = None,
187:     ) -> None:
188:         self.config = config if config is not None else SimulationConfig()
189:         self._mission = mission
190:         self._agent = agent
191:         self._frame_source = frame_source
192:         self._now = now_ns if now_ns is not None else time.perf_counter_ns
193:         self._sleep = sleep if sleep is not None else time.sleep
194: 
195:         sensor = _pick_sensor(agent)
196:         self.sensor_hz = float(
197:             self.config.sensor_hz
198:             if self.config.sensor_hz is not None
199:             else (sensor.rate_hz if sensor is not None else DEFAULT_SENSOR_HZ)
200:         )
201:         self.camera_id = sensor.id if sensor is not None else "sim.camera"
202:         self.frame_size = _frame_size(sensor)
203:         step_s = self.config.step_s if self.config.step_s is not None else 1.0 / self.sensor_hz
204:         self.clock = SimClock(
205:             step_s=step_s,
206:             scale=self.config.scale,
207:             realtime_drop=self.config.realtime_drop,
208:         )
209:         self.events = EventStream(clock_ns=self._now)
210:         self.supervisor = MissionSupervisor(mission, self.events, total_s=self._total_s())
211:         self.ring = FrameRing(slots=self.config.slots, slot_bytes=self.config.slot_bytes)
212:         self.injector = DegradationInjector(self.config.degradation)
213:         self.recorder = ScaleRecorder(self.config.interval_s)
214:         self.metrics = RunMetrics(
215:             realtime_drop=self.config.realtime_drop,
216:             degradation=self.injector.stats(),
217:         )
218:         self.stage_plan = self._stage_plan()
219:         self._slow_stage = "sensor" if "sensor" in self.stage_plan else next(iter(self.stage_plan))
220:         self._run_recorder = (
221:             RunRecorder(self.config.record_path, meta=self._stream_meta())
222:             if self.config.record_path is not None
223:             else None
224:         )
225:         self._state = RunState.IDLE
226:         self._frame_id = 0
227:         self._push_times: dict[int, int] = {}
228:         self._pending_wait_ms = 0.0
229:         self._stop = Event()
230:         self._pause = Event()
231:         self._lock = Lock()
232:         self._status_lock = Lock()
233:         self._report: RunReport | None = None
234: 
235:     # --- состояние ------------------------------------------------------
236: 
237:     @property
238:     def state(self) -> RunState:
239:         return self._state
240: 
241:     @property
242:     def report(self) -> RunReport | None:
243:         return self._report
244: 
245:     @property
246:     def status_path(self) -> Path | None:
247:         if self.config.report_path is None:
248:             return None
249:         target = Path(self.config.report_path)
250:         return target.with_name(f"{target.stem}.status.json")
251: 
252:     def pause(self) -> bool:
253:         """Пауза: такты прекращаются, состояние супервизора меняется."""
254:         if self.supervisor.state is not RunState.RUNNING:
255:             return False
256:         self._pause.set()
257:         self.clock.pause()
258:         self.supervisor.pause()
259:         self._state = self.supervisor.state
260:         self._write_status()
261:         return True
262: 
263:     def resume(self) -> bool:
264:         """Продолжение после паузы."""
265:         if self.supervisor.state is not RunState.PAUSED:
266:             return False
267:         self._pause.clear()
268:         self.supervisor.resume()
269:         self.clock.resume()
270:         self._state = self.supervisor.state
271:         self._write_status()
272:         return True
273: 
274:     def request_stop(self) -> None:
275:         """Просит прогон завершиться: поток останавливается на границе такта."""
276:         self._stop.set()
277: 
278:     def interrupt(self, reason: str) -> None:
279:         """Прерывает прогон и сохраняет артефакты."""
280:         self._stop.set()
281:         self.supervisor.interrupt(reason)
282:         self._write_status()
283: 
284:     def step_once(self) -> bool:
285:         """Один такт вручную (шаг вперёд) при паузе."""
286:         with self._lock:
287:             if self.supervisor.state is not RunState.PAUSED:
288:                 return False
289:             self.supervisor.resume()
290:             self.clock.resume()
291:             previous = self.clock.sim_time_s
292:             completed = self._tick(previous, paced=False)
293:             self.clock.pause()
294:             self.supervisor.pause()
295:             if completed:
296:                 self.supervisor.finish()
297:             self._state = self.supervisor.state
298:             self._write_status()
299:             return True
300: 
301:     # --- прогон ---------------------------------------------------------
302: 
303:     def run(self) -> RunReport:
304:         """Выполняет прогон до конца миссии или до сбоя."""
305:         if self._state is not RunState.IDLE:
306:             raise RuntimeError(f"прогон уже выполнялся: {self._state}")
307:         self.clock.start()
308:         self.supervisor.start()
309:         self._state = RunState.RUNNING
310:         self._write_status()
311:         previous = 0.0
312:         try:
313:             while not self._stop.is_set():
314:                 self._wait_if_paused()
315:                 if self._stop.is_set():
316:                     break
317:                 completed = self._tick(previous, paced=True)
318:                 previous = self.clock.sim_time_s
319:                 self._state = self.supervisor.state
320:                 if completed:
321:                     self.supervisor.finish()
322:                     break
323:             if self._stop.is_set() and self.supervisor.state not in (
324:                 RunState.FINISHED,
325:                 RunState.INTERRUPTED,
326:             ):
327:                 self.supervisor.interrupt("прогон остановлен пользователем")
328:         except Exception as exc:  # сбой симуляции не должен ломать UI (FR-SIM-14)
329:             self.supervisor.interrupt(f"сбой симуляции: {exc}")
330:         finally:
331:             self._state = self.supervisor.state
332:             self._finalize()

336:     # --- такт -----------------------------------------------------------
337: 
338:     def _tick(self, previous_s: float, *, paced: bool) -> bool:
339:         """Один такт: кадр, транспорт, часы, супервизор и метрики."""
340:         started_ns = self._now()
341:         t_scene_s = self.clock.sim_time_s
342:         self._frame_id += 1
343:         frame_id = self._frame_id
344:         fsin_ns = round(t_scene_s * 1e9)
345:         packet = FramePacket(
346:             frame_id=frame_id,
347:             t_fsin_ns=fsin_ns,
348:             t_monotonic_ns=started_ns,
349:             camera_id=self.camera_id,
350:             width=self.frame_size[0],
351:             height=self.frame_size[1],
352:             payload=self._payload(frame_id, fsin_ns),
353:         )
354:         self._push_frame(packet, fsin_ns)
355:         self._consume_frames()
356: 
357:         if self.config.work_ms > 0.0:
358:             self._sleep(self.config.work_ms / 1000.0)
359:         work_ns = max(0, self._now() - started_ns)
360:         stages, wall_ms = self._stage_actuals(work_ns)
361:         wall_ns = round(wall_ms * 1e6)
362:         target_ns = round(self.clock.target_interval_s * 1e9)
363:         if paced and self.config.pace:
364:             wall_ns = max(wall_ns, target_ns)
365:             spent_ns = max(0, self._now() - started_ns)
366:             if wall_ns > spent_ns:
367:                 self._sleep((wall_ns - spent_ns) / 1e9)
368:         self.clock.tick(wall_ns / 1e9)
369:         self.metrics.ticks = self.clock.ticks
370:         self.metrics.pc_time_s = self.clock.wall_time_s
371:         self.metrics.scene_time_s = self.clock.sim_time_s
372:         self.supervisor.advance(previous_s, self.clock.sim_time_s)
373:         self.recorder.observe_tick(
374:             stages,
375:             queue_depth=self.ring.depth,
376:             queue_wait_ms=self._pending_wait_ms,
377:         )
378:         sample = self.recorder.maybe_close(self.clock.sim_time_s, self.clock.wall_time_s)
379:         if sample is not None:
380:             self.metrics.intervals.append(sample)
381:         return self.supervisor.complete(self.clock.sim_time_s)
382: 
383:     def _push_frame(self, packet: FramePacket, fsin_ns: int) -> None:
384:         injected = self.injector.apply(packet)
385:         if injected is None:
386:             self.metrics.frames_dropped += 1
387:             self.events.emit(
388:                 EventKind.FRAME_DROPPED,
389:                 f"кадр {packet.frame_id} потерян при инжекции",
390:                 t_scene_ns=fsin_ns,
391:                 frame_id=packet.frame_id,
392:                 cause="degradation",
393:             )
394:             return
395:         dropped_before = self.ring.dropped
396:         pushed = self.ring.push(injected, drop_oldest=self.config.realtime_drop)
397:         overwritten = self.ring.dropped - dropped_before
398:         if overwritten:
399:             self.metrics.frames_dropped += overwritten
400:             self.events.emit(
401:                 EventKind.FRAME_DROPPED,
402:                 f"перезаписано кадров: {overwritten}",
403:                 t_scene_ns=fsin_ns,
404:                 frame_id=packet.frame_id,
405:                 cause="realtime_drop",
406:             )
407:         if not pushed:
408:             self.metrics.frames_dropped += 1
409:             self.events.emit(
410:                 EventKind.FRAME_DROPPED,
411:                 f"кадр {packet.frame_id} не поместился в кольцо",
412:                 t_scene_ns=fsin_ns,
413:                 frame_id=packet.frame_id,
414:                 cause="full",
415:             )
416:             return
417:         self.metrics.frames_pushed += 1
418:         self._push_times[packet.frame_id] = self._now()
419:         self.events.emit(
420:             EventKind.FRAME_PUSHED,
421:             f"кадр {packet.frame_id}",
422:             t_scene_ns=fsin_ns,
423:             frame_id=packet.frame_id,
424:             camera_id=packet.camera_id,
425:             depth=self.ring.depth,
426:         )
427: 
428:     def _consume_frames(self) -> None:
429:         for item in self.ring.drain():
430:             self.metrics.frames_consumed += 1
431:             pushed_ns = self._push_times.pop(item.frame_id, item.t_monotonic_ns)
432:             wait_ms = max(0.0, (self._now() - pushed_ns) / 1e6)
433:             self._pending_wait_ms = max(self._pending_wait_ms, wait_ms)
434:             if self._run_recorder is not None:
435:                 self._run_recorder.append(item)
436:             self.events.emit(
437:                 EventKind.FRAME_CONSUMED,
438:                 f"кадр {item.frame_id}",
439:                 t_scene_ns=item.t_fsin_ns,
440:                 frame_id=item.frame_id,
441:                 wait_ms=round(wait_ms, 3),
442:             )
443: 
444:     # --- служебное ------------------------------------------------------
445: 
446:     def _wait_if_paused(self) -> None:
447:         while self._pause.is_set() and not self._stop.is_set():
448:             self._sleep(0.005)
449: 
450:     def _total_s(self) -> float:
451:         probe = MissionSupervisor(self._mission, self.events)
452:         if self.config.duration_s is not None:
453:             return float(self.config.duration_s)
454:         if probe.total_s > 0.0:
455:             return probe.total_s
456:         return DEFAULT_DURATION_S
457: 
458:     def _stage_plan(self) -> dict[str, float]:
459:         if self.config.stage_plan_ms is not None:
460:             plans = {name: float(value) for name, value in self.config.stage_plan_ms.items()}
461:             if not plans:
462:                 raise ValueError("план ступеней пуст")
463:             if any(value <= 0.0 for value in plans.values()):
464:                 raise ValueError("план ступени должен быть положительным")
465:             return plans
466:         return {"sensor": 1000.0 / self.sensor_hz}
467: 
468:     def _stage_actuals(self, work_ns: int) -> tuple[dict[str, tuple[float, float]], float]:
469:         """Раскладывает фактическое время по ступеням и добавляет замедление."""
470:         total_plan = sum(self.stage_plan.values())
471:         actual_total_ms = work_ns / 1e6
472:         stages: dict[str, tuple[float, float]] = {}
473:         wall_ms = actual_total_ms
474:         for name, plan in self.stage_plan.items():
475:             share = plan / total_plan
476:             actual_ms = actual_total_ms * share
477:             if name == self._slow_stage and self.config.slowdown != 1.0:
478:                 extra = actual_ms * (self.config.slowdown - 1.0)
479:                 actual_ms += extra
480:                 wall_ms += extra
481:             stages[name] = (plan, actual_ms)
482:         return stages, wall_ms
483: 
484:     def _payload(self, frame_id: int, fsin_ns: int) -> bytes:
485:         if self._frame_source is not None:
486:             return self._frame_source(frame_id, fsin_ns)
487:         digest = hashlib.sha256(f"{self.config.seed}:{frame_id}:{fsin_ns}".encode()).digest()
488:         size = self.config.frame_bytes
489:         if size <= len(digest):
490:             return digest[:size]
491:         repeats = size // len(digest)
492:         return digest * repeats + digest[: size % len(digest)]
493: 
494:     def _stream_meta(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
495:         return {
496:             "mission_id": self._mission.mission_id,
497:             "agent_id": self._mission.agent_id,
498:             "sensor_hz": self.sensor_hz,
499:             "step_s": self.clock.step_s,
500:             "scale": self.clock.scale,
501:             "camera_id": self.camera_id,
502:             "width": self.frame_size[0],
503:             "height": self.frame_size[1],
504:             "seed": self.config.seed,
505:             "realtime_drop": self.config.realtime_drop,
506:             "degradation": self.config.degradation.to_dict(),
507:         }
508: 
509:     def _finalize(self) -> None:
510:         """Собирает остатки, закрывает поток и пишет отчёт."""
511:         self._consume_frames()
512:         sample = self.recorder.flush(self.clock.sim_time_s, self.clock.wall_time_s)
513:         if sample is not None:
514:             self.metrics.intervals.append(sample)
515:         self.metrics.ticks = self.clock.ticks
516:         self.metrics.pc_time_s = self.clock.wall_time_s
517:         self.metrics.scene_time_s = self.clock.sim_time_s
518:         self.metrics.queue = self.supervisor.queue.to_dict()
519:         self.metrics.queue["frame_max_depth"] = max(
520:             (item.queue_depth for item in self.metrics.intervals), default=0
521:         )
522:         self.metrics.queue["frame_max_wait_ms"] = round(
523:             max((item.queue_wait_ms for item in self.metrics.intervals), default=0.0), 3
524:         )
525:         self.metrics.degradation = self.injector.stats()
526:         if self._run_recorder is not None:
527:             self._run_recorder.close()
528:         self._report = self._build_report()
529:         if self.config.report_path is not None:
530:             _write_json(self.config.report_path, self._report.to_dict())
531:         self._write_status()
532: 
533:     def _build_report(self) -> RunReport:
534:         attempted = self.clock.ticks
535:         dropped = self.metrics.frames_dropped
536:         frames = {
537:             "attempted": attempted,
538:             "pushed": self.metrics.frames_pushed,
539:             "consumed": self.metrics.frames_consumed,
540:             "dropped": dropped,
541:             "loss_ratio": round(dropped / attempted, 6) if attempted else 0.0,
542:             "ring": self.ring.stats(),
543:         }
544:         return RunReport(
545:             mission_id=self._mission.mission_id,
546:             agent_id=self._mission.agent_id,
547:             state=str(self._state),
548:             reason=self.supervisor.reason,
549:             config=self.config.to_dict(),
550:             clock=self.clock.to_dict(),
551:             supervisor=self.supervisor.to_dict(),
552:             metrics=self.metrics.to_dict(),
553:             frames=frames,
554:             events=self.events.to_payload(),
555:             record=None if self.config.record_path is None else str(self.config.record_path),
556:             status=None if self.status_path is None else str(self.status_path),
557:         )
558: 
559:     def _write_status(self) -> None:
560:         path = self.status_path
561:         if path is None:
562:             return
563:         payload = {
564:             "state": str(self.supervisor.state),
565:             "reason": self.supervisor.reason,
566:             "pid": os.getpid(),
567:             "updated_ns": self._now(),
568:             "mission_id": self._mission.mission_id,
569:         }
570:         with self._status_lock:
571:             _write_json(path, payload)
572: 
573:     def close(self) -> None:
574:         """Освобождает кольцо и файл потока."""
575:         if self._run_recorder is not None:
576:             self._run_recorder.close()
577:         self.ring.close()
578: 
579: 
580: def _pick_sensor(agent: AgentSection | None) -> Sensor | None:
581:     if agent is None:
582:         return None
583:     for sensor in agent.sensors:
584:         if sensor.type in {"camera", "stereo_camera"}:
585:             return sensor
586:     return agent.sensors[0] if agent.sensors else None
587: 
588: 
589: def _frame_size(sensor: Sensor | None) -> tuple[int, int]:
590:     if sensor is None or sensor.resolution is None:
591:         return (640, 480)
592:     width, height = sensor.resolution
593:     return (int(width), int(height))

596: def _write_json(path: Path, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
597:     """Пишет JSON атомарно: недописанный файл не попадёт на место готового."""
598:     target = Path(path)
599:     target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
600:     temporary = target.with_name(f"{target.name}.tmp")
601:     temporary.write_text(
602:         json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n",
603:         encoding="utf-8",
604:     )
605:     temporary.replace(target)
606: 
607: 
608: def read_status(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
609:     """Читает файл состояния прогона; отсутствие файла — ``interrupted``."""
610:     target = Path(path)
611:     try:
612:         payload = json.loads(target.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
613:     except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError):
614:         return {"state": str(RunState.INTERRUPTED), "reason": "файл состояния недоступен"}
615:     return payload if isinstance(payload, dict) else {"state": str(RunState.INTERRUPTED)}
616: 
617: 
618: def effective_state(status: dict[str, Any], *, alive: bool | None = None) -> str:
619:     """Состояние с учётом живости процесса.
620: 
621:     Если процесс умер, а состояние осталось ``running``, прогон считается
622:     прерванным: артефакты могли не дописаться, но журнал читаем (G7-07).
623:     """
624:     state = str(status.get("state", RunState.INTERRUPTED))
625:     if state == str(RunState.RUNNING) and alive is False:
626:         return str(RunState.INTERRUPTED)

1: """Команды ``simorph sim``: headless-прогон и replay (этап 7).
2: 
3: ``sim run`` исполняет миссию без 3D-окна и печатает метрики мягкого
4: масштаба. ``sim replay`` читает записанный поток и сверяет хэши кадров,
5: не запуская физику. Обе команды работают с тем же раннером, что и вкладка
6: «Симуляция», поэтому оконный и headless-режимы дают одинаковые числа.
7: 
8: Код возврата: 0 — успех, 1 — ошибка данных или незавершённый прогон.
9: """
10: 
11: from __future__ import annotations
12: 
13: import argparse
14: import json
15: import logging
16: import sys
17: from pathlib import Path
18: from typing import Any
19: 
20: from simorph.cli.exit_codes import ExitCode
21: from simorph.cli.project import add_common_options
22: from simorph.core.errors import ProjectError
23: from simorph.core.models.agent import AgentSection
24: from simorph.core.models.exercise import ExerciseSection, Mission
25: from simorph.core.models.project import ProjectDocument
26: from simorph.core.repository import load_project
27: from simorph.core.simulation import (
28:     Degradation,
29:     SimulationConfig,
30:     SimulationRunner,
31:     replay_stream,
32: )
33: 
34: __all__ = ["build_sim_parser", "run_sim_command"]
35: 
36: 
37: def build_sim_parser(subparsers: Any) -> None:
38:     """Регистрирует подкоманды ``sim``."""
39:     sim = subparsers.add_parser("sim", help="симуляция: прогон и replay потока")
40:     add_common_options(sim)
41:     actions = sim.add_subparsers(dest="sim_command", metavar="ДЕЙСТВИЕ")
42: 
43:     run_parser = actions.add_parser("run", help="headless-прогон миссии")
44:     add_common_options(run_parser)
45:     run_parser.add_argument("path", type=Path, help="путь к project.json")
46:     run_parser.add_argument("--exercise", type=int, default=0, help="номер упражнения")
47:     run_parser.add_argument("--mission", type=int, default=0, help="номер миссии")
48:     run_parser.add_argument("--scale", type=float, default=1.0, help="целевой масштаб времени")
49:     run_parser.add_argument("--step", type=float, default=None, help="шаг физики, с")
50:     run_parser.add_argument("--duration", type=float, default=None, help="длительность, с")
51:     run_parser.add_argument("--slots", type=int, default=3, help="слотов в кольце (2–4)")
52:     run_parser.add_argument(
53:         "--realtime-drop",
54:         action="store_true",
55:         help="явно разрешить отбрасывание кадров при переполнении",
56:     )
57:     run_parser.add_argument("--latency-ms", type=float, default=0.0, help="задержка сенсора, мс")
58:     run_parser.add_argument("--loss", type=float, default=0.0, help="доля потерь кадров 0…1")
59:     run_parser.add_argument("--desync-ms", type=float, default=0.0, help="рассинхронизация ±0,5 мс")
60:     run_parser.add_argument("--jitter-us", type=float, default=0.0, help="джиттер выдержки, мкс")
61:     run_parser.add_argument("--work-ms", type=float, default=0.0, help="искусственная работа такта")
62:     run_parser.add_argument("--slowdown", type=float, default=1.0, help="замедление ступени, раз")
63:     run_parser.add_argument("--record", type=Path, default=None, help="записать поток кадров")
64:     run_parser.add_argument("--report", type=Path, default=None, help="записать отчёт JSON")
65:     run_parser.add_argument(
66:         "--no-pace",
67:         action="store_true",
68:         help="не выдерживать плановый интервал (максимальная скорость)",
69:     )
70: 
71:     replay_parser = actions.add_parser("replay", help="воспроизвести поток без физики")
72:     add_common_options(replay_parser)
73:     replay_parser.add_argument("path", type=Path, help="файл потока")
74:     replay_parser.add_argument(
75:         "--no-compare",
76:         action="store_true",
77:         help="только прочитать поток, не сверяя хэши",
78:     )

80: 
81: def _write(text: str) -> None:
82:     sys.stdout.write(f"{text}\n")
83: 
84: 
85: def _write_json(payload: object) -> None:
86:     _write(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
87: 
88: 
89: def _load(path: Path) -> ProjectDocument:
90:     return load_project(path).document
91: 
92: 
93: def _exercise(document: ProjectDocument, index: int) -> ExerciseSection:
94:     if not document.exercises:
95:         raise ProjectError("в проекте нет упражнений")
96:     if not 0 <= index < len(document.exercises):
97:         raise ProjectError(
98:             f"упражнение с номером {index} не найдено: в проекте {len(document.exercises)}"
99:         )
100:     return document.exercises[index]
101: 
102: 
103: def _mission(exercise: ExerciseSection, index: int) -> Mission:
104:     if not exercise.missions:
105:         raise ProjectError(f"в упражнении {exercise.exercise_id!r} нет миссий")
106:     if not 0 <= index < len(exercise.missions):
107:         raise ProjectError(
108:             f"миссия с номером {index} не найдена: в упражнении {len(exercise.missions)}"
109:         )
110:     return exercise.missions[index]
111: 
112: 
113: def _agent(document: ProjectDocument, mission: Mission) -> AgentSection | None:
114:     for agent in document.agents:
115:         if agent.agent_id == mission.agent_id:
116:             return agent
117:     return None
118: 
119: 
120: def _cmd_run(args: argparse.Namespace, *, as_json: bool, logger: logging.Logger) -> int:
121:     document = _load(args.path)
122:     exercise = _exercise(document, args.exercise)
123:     mission = _mission(exercise, args.mission)
124:     config = SimulationConfig(
125:         scale=args.scale,
126:         step_s=args.step,
127:         duration_s=args.duration,
128:         slots=args.slots,
129:         realtime_drop=bool(args.realtime_drop),
130:         degradation=Degradation(
131:             sensor_latency_ms=args.latency_ms,
132:             frame_loss_ratio=args.loss,
133:             desync_ms=args.desync_ms,
134:             exposure_jitter_us=args.jitter_us,
135:         ),
136:         work_ms=args.work_ms,
137:         slowdown=args.slowdown,
138:         record_path=args.record,
139:         report_path=args.report,
140:         pace=not args.no_pace,
141:     )
142:     runner = SimulationRunner(mission, agent=_agent(document, mission), config=config)
143:     try:
144:         report = runner.run()
145:     finally:
146:         runner.close()
147:     if as_json:
148:         _write_json(report.to_dict())
149:     else:
150:         _write(report.summary())
151:         _write(
152:             f"масштаб {report.clock.get('scale', 1.0):g}"
153:             f" · шаг {report.clock.get('step_s', 0.0) * 1000:.2f} мс"
154:             f" · интервалов {report.metrics.get('intervals', 0)}"
155:             f" · потеря {report.loss_ratio * 100:.2f}%"
156:         )
157:         if report.record:
158:             _write(f"поток: {report.record}")
159:         if report.status:
160:             _write(f"состояние: {report.status}")
161:         if report.reason:
162:             _write(f"причина: {report.reason}")
163:     if not report.ok:
164:         logger.error("прогон не завершён: %s (%s)", report.state, report.reason)
165:         return int(ExitCode.DATA_ERROR)
166:     return int(ExitCode.OK)
167: 
168: 
169: def _cmd_replay(args: argparse.Namespace, *, as_json: bool, logger: logging.Logger) -> int:
170:     report = replay_stream(args.path, compare=not args.no_compare)
171:     if as_json:
172:         _write_json(report.to_dict())
173:     else:
174:         _write(
175:             f"поток {report.source}: кадров {report.frames}"
176:             f" · совпало {report.matched}"
177:             f" · расхождений {len(report.mismatched)}"
178:             f" · нарушений меток {len(report.bad_timing)}"
179:         )
180:         if report.mismatched:
181:             _write(f"  расхождения: {', '.join(str(i) for i in report.mismatched[:10])}")
182:         if report.bad_timing:
183:             _write(f"  метки: {', '.join(str(i) for i in report.bad_timing[:10])}")
184:     if not report.ok:
185:         logger.error(
186:             "replay не совпал: расхождений %d, нарушений меток %d",
187:             len(report.mismatched),
188:             len(report.bad_timing),
189:         )
190:         return int(ExitCode.DATA_ERROR)
191:     return int(ExitCode.OK)
192: 
193: 
194: def run_sim_command(args: argparse.Namespace, *, as_json: bool, logger: logging.Logger) -> int:
195:     """Диспетчер подкоманд ``sim``."""
196:     command = getattr(args, "sim_command", None)
197:     try:
198:         if command == "run":
199:             return _cmd_run(args, as_json=as_json, logger=logger)
200:         if command == "replay":
201:             return _cmd_replay(args, as_json=as_json, logger=logger)
202:     except (ProjectError, ValueError) as exc:

206:         else:
207:             sys.stderr.write(f"simorph: {exc}\n")
208:         return int(ExitCode.DATA_ERROR)

1: """Headless-прогон миссии: часы, кадры, супервизор и метрики (T7-05, G7-01).
2: 
3: Раннер — единственный сценарий исполнения: его используют и CLI
4: (``simorph sim run``), и вкладка «Симуляция». Оконный режим добавляет
5: только визуализацию, поэтому метрики совпадают.
6: 
7: Один такт делает ровно одно и то же: выпускает кадр с метками времени,
8: пропускает его через инжекцию деградации, кладёт в кольцо, забирает
9: готовые кадры, продвигает часы и супервизор, пишет статистику. Такт
10: никогда не пропускается: при нехватке производительности растягивается
11: время PC, а не время сцены (мягкий масштаб, FR-SIM-16).
12: 
13: Сбой внутри такта не выходит наружу: прогон переводится в ``interrupted``,

80:     def __post_init__(self) -> None:
81:         if self.sensor_hz is not None and self.sensor_hz <= 0.0:
82:             raise ValueError("частота источника должна быть положительной")
83:         if self.step_s is not None and self.step_s <= 0.0:
84:             raise ValueError("шаг физики должен быть положительным")
85:         if self.frame_bytes < 1:
86:             raise ValueError("размер кадра должен быть положительным")
87:         if self.work_ms < 0.0:
88:             raise ValueError("искусственная работа не может быть отрицательной")
89:         if self.slowdown <= 0.0:
90:             raise ValueError("замедление ступени должно быть положительным")
91:         if self.duration_s is not None and self.duration_s <= 0.0:
92:             raise ValueError("длительность прогона должна быть положительной")
93: 
94:     def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
95:         return {
96:             "sensor_hz": self.sensor_hz,
97:             "step_s": self.step_s,
98:             "scale": self.scale,
99:             "duration_s": self.duration_s,
100:             "slots": self.slots,
101:             "slot_bytes": self.slot_bytes,
102:             "frame_bytes": self.frame_bytes,
103:             "work_ms": self.work_ms,
104:             "slowdown": self.slowdown,
105:             "realtime_drop": self.realtime_drop,
106:             "degradation": self.degradation.to_dict(),
107:             "record_path": None if self.record_path is None else str(self.record_path),
108:             "report_path": None if self.report_path is None else str(self.report_path),
109:             "interval_s": self.interval_s,
110:             "stage_plan_ms": None if self.stage_plan_ms is None else dict(self.stage_plan_ms),
111:             "pace": self.pace,
112:             "seed": self.seed,
113:         }
114:

116: @dataclass(slots=True)
117: class RunReport:
118:     """Итог прогона: состояние, метрики, кадры и события."""
119: 
120:     mission_id: str
121:     agent_id: str
122:     state: str
123:     reason: str | None
124:     config: dict[str, Any]
125:     clock: dict[str, Any]
126:     supervisor: dict[str, Any]
127:     metrics: dict[str, Any]
128:     frames: dict[str, Any]
129:     events: list[dict[str, Any]]
130:     record: str | None = None
131:     status: str | None = None
132:

134:     def ok(self) -> bool:
135:         return self.state == str(RunState.FINISHED)
136: 
137:     @property
138:     def loss_ratio(self) -> float:
139:         return float(self.frames.get("loss_ratio", 0.0))
140: 
141:     def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
142:         return {
143:             "status": "ok" if self.ok else "error",
144:             "state": self.state,
145:             "reason": self.reason,
146:             "mission_id": self.mission_id,
147:             "agent_id": self.agent_id,
148:             "config": dict(self.config),
149:             "clock": dict(self.clock),
150:             "supervisor": dict(self.supervisor),
151:             "metrics": dict(self.metrics),
152:             "frames": dict(self.frames),
153:             "events": list(self.events),
154:             "record": self.record,
155:             "status_file": self.status,
156:         }

158:     def summary(self) -> str:
159:         """Короткая сводка для CLI и панели прогона."""
160:         frames = self.frames
161:         return (
162:             f"прогон {self.state}: миссия {self.mission_id} ({self.agent_id})"
163:             f" · сцена {self.clock.get('sim_time_s', 0.0):.1f} с"
164:             f" · PC {self.clock.get('wall_time_s', 0.0):.1f} с"
165:             f" · тактов {frames.get('attempted', 0)}"
166:             f" · кадров {frames.get('pushed', 0)}/{frames.get('consumed', 0)}"
167:             f" · потерь {frames.get('dropped', 0)}"
168:             f" ({self.loss_ratio * 100:.2f}%)"
169:             f" · k p50 {self.metrics.get('k', {}).get('p50', 1.0):.2f},"
170:             f" p95 {self.metrics.get('k', {}).get('p95', 1.0):.2f}"
171:             f" · событий {len(self.events)}"
172:         )
